facts.fact: 老年旁白：Alexander 在车祸两年后的秋天死去，天气阴冷潮湿（dreich）。
facts.anchor: Alexander died two years after the car crash. It was autumn, a dreich day

facts.fact: 她不确定 Nick 是否愿意让他死；Nick 不在时 Alexander 更沉默、更暴躁。
facts.anchor: I was not sure if Nick would let him die

facts.fact: 他死前她长时间坐在他床边；医生说他心脏太磨损，无能为力。
facts.anchor: Before he died, I sat by his side for long hours

facts.fact: 她追问：咒语要求的「珍贵牺牲」本该是她吗。
facts.anchor: It was supposed to be me, was it not?

facts.fact: 他说新婚夜他下不了手，因为她看起来那么有希望、那么迷失、那么爱他。
facts.anchor: When I came to you that night, our wedding night, I could not bring myself to do it

facts.fact: 那一夜他嘴里的味道是绝望与渴望——他爱的另有其人，她不过是个可用的身体。
facts.anchor: What I tasted in his mouth that night had been desperation, an aching loneliness

facts.fact: 她告诉他 Nick 不需要牺牲、随时都能来，这是他珍藏多年的「临终礼物」。
facts.anchor: He could have come to you at any time

facts.fact: 葬礼上乌鸦落在新坟上低头如祈祷；她望向天空找魔鬼的渡鸦，问谁赢了。
facts.anchor: I searched the sky for a raven
